mapper.select: select * from user_health_profile where patient_id_hash = #{patientIdHash} and active = 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_health_profile( patient_id_hash, id_number_hash, gender, birth_date, height_cm, weight_kg, blood_type, special_status, source, confirmed, active ) values ( #{patientIdHash}, #{idNumberHash}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{heightCm}, #{weightKg}, #{bloodType}, #{specialStatus}, #{source}, #{confirmed}, #{active} )
mapper.update: update user_health_profile set id_number_hash = #{idNumberHash}, gender = #{gender}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, height_cm = #{heightCm}, weight_kg = #{weightKg}, blood_type = #{bloodType}, special_status = #{specialStatus}, source = #{source}, confirmed = #{confirmed}, active = #{active} where patient_id_hash = #{patientIdHash}
